output.text:
Lena: I found the red scarf in shreds—did you borrow it without asking? 
Jake: I’m sorry, I didn’t mean to. I just needed it for the walk. 
Lena: Next time, ask next time. It’s not just a piece of cloth—it’s Mom’s gift. 
Jake: I know. I’ll fix it. 
Lena: We can mend it. Let’s use the needle and thread from the drawer. 
Jake: Yes, we can mend it. Together. 
Lena: Good. The red scarf will be better than new.
